analysis_lane.could_not_check_is_not_a_pass: GR0d and GR0e return COULD_NOT_CHECK, distinct from PASS and from FAIL, with a distinct process exit code; it routes to EXECUTION_NOT_COMPLETED__NO_ENDPOINT_READ
analysis_lane.denominators_are_published: both gates report envelopes_expected, envelopes_with_a_channel_receipt and the model-call counts, so '0 offenders' can never be read out of '0 envelopes examined'
analysis_lane.endpoint_arithmetic: IMPORTED from research/experiments/e30-r12/e30_r12_analysis.py under a sha256 pin asserted at run time. build_tables, family, evaluate_gates and route are reused verbatim, so R13's endpoint definitions are the same CODE as R12's rather than a similar transcription of them. E30-R12's file is frozen and not modified.

exit_codes.3: a precondition refused; no endpoint read
exit_codes.5: a channel gate COULD NOT BE CHECKED

analysis_lane.halt_is_literal: HALT_NO_GATE_EVALUATION is implemented as a halt, not as a routing decision taken afterwards: GR0c, GR0d and GR0e are evaluated BEFORE any endpoint table is built, and a non-PASS on any of them writes a refusal artifact carrying the gates and the terminal and nothing else. A halted run that still emitted contrast estimates would leave numbers the design forbids in the rollup for a later reader to quote as results.

class: new prospective confirmatory study under a NEW campaign identity; not a re-analysis and not a repair of E30-R12's campaign

custody.authorization_archived_after_use: the rollup step renames it to PROTECTED_RUN_AUTHORIZATION_ARCHIVED.json, so the dispatch guard re-arms and a later resubmission cannot run on a spent authorization
custody.authorization_object: PROTECTED_RUN_AUTHORIZATION.json, written into the campaign directory by the coordinator (not by a human) and carrying coordinator_written: true, the verbatim operator instruction with its source, and the exact design sha256. It does NOT claim human authorship, because it is not human-written; what is asserted is that the human instruction it quotes is present and attributed. The dispatch gate refuses to run without it.
custody.calibration_custody: the channel calibration ran on frozen prompts OUTSIDE any campaign run tree, recorded token accounting, stop reasons, content-block shapes and a JSON-parseability boolean only, retained no response text, evaluated no patch, read no gold tree and read no endpoint. Its outputs are archived under results/ and are not pooled into the campaign.
custody.gold_blindness: arms read only the gold-blind solver workspace; gold patches are read only by GR0b, after all responses are written
custody.seed_disclosure: The seed is published in the clear here, before dispatch, AND as its sha256. A hash-commit-then-reveal protocol would be weaker in this study, not stronger: the seed is a bootstrap resampling seed compiled into e30_r13_analysis.py, which is frozen and hashed by the same pull request as this design, so it is already publicly checkable and cannot be re-chosen after an outcome. Claiming a commit-and-reveal that was not run would be a rendered status standing in for the thing itself.

execution_lane_contract.cap_is_set_per_call_not_as_a_total: ORION_ARM_MAX_TOKENS is set directly and ORION_ARM_TOTAL_OUTPUT_TOKEN_BUDGET is unset, so every arm gets the identical per-call cap

derivation.generator: e30_r13_budget_note.py, pure arithmetic over e30_r13_channel_calibration.py output; no outcome input

execution_lane_contract.escalation_ladder: NONE. The cap is derived to be non-binding; a call that stops at max_tokens is a GR0e channel-behaviour violation to be reported, not a resource shortfall to be topped up mid-campaign. An escalation ladder applied after seeing failures is an unregistered instrument change.
execution_lane_contract.resumability: each pass rescans the response envelopes and re-invokes the arm ONLY where the response is absent or carries EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE (an envelope failure holds no model output, so re-dispatching it is execution repair, not resampling). A COMPLETED_PROPOSAL_ONLY response is never touched.

wall_time_feasibility.consequence: under the provider default at E30-R12's registered escalated budget the 1080-call campaign does not fit in a single SLURM allocation at any concurrency this lane uses; the registered contract is chosen on feasibility as well as on correctness

execution_lane_contract.why_registered: E30-R12 registered a primary budget of 6000 and an escalation to 36000 from pass 3. In execution 116 of 116 failures sat at or above the primary cap, and a diagnostic run of one cell at the escalated budget closed at 35937 output tokens with a 161644-character thinking block and 5895 characters of text after 786 s. Because the runner divides the registered total by the arm's call count, F0_PARENT_FEDERATION and F2_ORION_METABOLIC_FULL would each have received 12000 per call, a third of what one call needed to close.

gates.name: LANE_SELF_CONSISTENCY
gates.statement: the full-regression lane's registered-failing-test result reproduces the campaign's own frozen-lane (e30_r11_arm_eval_frozen_lane.py) native_success vector bit-exactly for all 480 evaluations
gates.why_it_differs_from_pc_r6: PC-R6's GR0(a) checked against a pre-existing frozen vector; R12 has no prior vector, so R12 runs BOTH evaluators over its own 480 proposals and requires them to agree. Disagreement is a lane defect: halt, receipt, re-freeze.

gates.gold_access: this stage and only this stage reads gold patches; its records are marked gold_or_fixed_solution_accessed = true and it runs after all arm responses are written
gates.name: GOLD_KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTROL
gates.statement: on a frozen 5-task subset (one per project where available) the task's gold patch flips the registered failing test to passing AND yields critical_new_failure_count == 0 under the same suite definition

gates.name: SERVED_MODEL_HOMOGENEITY
gates.statement: every one of the 480 response envelopes records exactly one served model id and all 480 are identical and equal to the frozen served model

gates.interpretation: GR1 measures whether the emission fix worked. GR1 failing does not invalidate E1/E2; it means R12 measured a still-broken interface and must say so.
gates.name: APPLY_RATE_DIAGNOSTIC
gates.statement: D1: every arm's patch-apply FAIL rate is below 0.40, and below its PC-R6 comparator

gates.name: PRIMARY_SEPARATION
gates.note: given the power note, non-rejection is the expected outcome and is not evidence of equivalence
gates.statement: E1: any of the three F2-vs-control contrasts rejects at Holm-adjusted alpha 0.05

gates.name: CRITICAL_NON_INFERIORITY
gates.non_compensatory: an E1 gain cannot offset a GR3 failure (analysis plan section 6)
gates.statement: E2: upper bound of the one-sided 97.5% CI for RD(any_critical_new_failure: F2 - F0) <= 0.02

gates.compared_by: sha256 over the contract bytes, not by the contract's label
gates.name: CHANNEL_CONTRACT_HOMOGENEITY
gates.statement: every one of the 480 response envelopes carries a channel_receipt recording exactly one request-body contract sha256, and it equals the registered contract's fingerprint; every model call within every envelope reported a contract.
gates.why_it_exists: E30-R12's GR0c held on all 119 envelopes it saw while the experimental condition moved. A gate over the served model id cannot see a change in the request body.

gates.name: CHANNEL_BEHAVIOUR_CONFORMANCE
gates.statement: no model call in any response envelope stopped at max_tokens, and no model call emitted zero text characters.
gates.why_it_exists: this is the behavioural half of the same lesson: E30-R12's 116 failures were exactly truncation-with-no-text at a correct served model id under a correct-looking configuration.

model_binding.per_envelope_channel_record: channel_receipt {model_calls, calls_reporting_a_contract, contract_ids, contract_sha256s, stop_reasons, calls_with_zero_text_chars, max_output_tokens_observed}
model_binding.post_hoc_homogeneity_assertion: GR0d refuses any contrast unless every response envelope in both arms records exactly one contract sha256 and it equals the frozen one

request_body_contract.selected_by: ORION_ARM_CHANNEL_CONTRACT; an unknown value raises ChannelContractUnknown rather than falling back to the default
request_body_contract.system: You are a bounded experimental software-debugging arm.
request_body_contract.what_is_registered_and_what_is_not: What is registered is the BYTES of the request body and three GATEABLE PROPERTIES of the response: stop_reason == end_turn, text characters > 0, and output tokens below the cap. This design does NOT claim that the contract disables the provider's reasoning: under thinking:{type:disabled} the measured response still carried a thinking block (745 characters in E30-R12's probe). Claiming otherwise would be an inference where a measurement is available.

model_binding.served_model_assertion: every call reads data['model'] from the response body and raises ServedModelMismatch unless it equals ORION_ARM_SERVED_MODEL exactly; the exception is re-raised out of run_arm rather than being folded into an EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE envelope, so the arm exits non-zero
model_binding.substrate_alert: the z.ai Anthropic-compatible endpoint silently serves glm-5.3 for a glm-5.2 request (verified live 2026-09-02: requested glm-5.2 -> served 'glm-5.3'; requested glm-5.3 -> served 'glm-5.3'). Pinning the requested id is not sufficient; the served id is what is asserted.

no_rescue_clause.a_null_is_a_result: if the arms still do not separate once patches apply, that is a real and important result and is reported as plainly as a positive would be

use the apply-rate diagnostic to re-read E30-R11's null as anything other than what E30-R11's own terminal receipt states

drop a task after observing which arm fails on it
re-roll a completed model response; only EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE envelopes (which contain no model output) may be re-dispatched, exactly as E30-R11's guarded redispatch did

power_note.consequence_for_r13: E30-R13 is registered as an ESTIMATION AND DIAGNOSTIC study at n = 40, exactly as E30-R12 was. It is NOT a powered superiority test and a non-rejection is NOT evidence of equivalence.
power_note.generator: research/experiments/e30-r12/e30_r12_power_note.py (pure arithmetic, exact enumeration, no outcome input); its archived output is carried forward unchanged because the substrate, the denominator and the test are unchanged

available_pool.counted_on: inputs/BugsInPy-base/projects/*/bugs, numeric ids only, all carrying bug.info

n_was_reconsidered_and_stays_at_40.considered: raising n toward the 430 tasks that 80% power at the 5 pp MID would need at psi = 0.10
n_was_reconsidered_and_stays_at_40.decision: n stays at 40 and the study stays an estimation and diagnostic study. E30-R12 died without asking its question; a substrate build that consumes the window and leaves the question unasked again reaches the same terminal by a longer route.
n_was_reconsidered_and_stays_at_40.measured_blocker: the frozen substrate holds prepared solver workspaces and baseline lanes for exactly 40 tasks (counted on the campaign tree: prepared/solver_public = 40 entries, baseline_lanes = 40 entries). Reaching 430 tasks means building ~390 further gold-blind workspaces, per-project offline runtimes and baseline lanes before a single model call.
n_was_reconsidered_and_stays_at_40.verdict_carried_forward: even the whole benchmark is underpowered for 5 pp at psi >= 0.20; a powered confirmatory test of the registered MID requires either a materially larger real-problem substrate than BugsInPy or a registered MID raised to what n=40 (>= 0.175) or n=295 (see the note generator) can actually detect. Raising the MID after seeing outcomes is prohibited; it may only be re-registered for a future study before dispatch.

power_note.plain_statement: 40 tasks CANNOT detect a plausible effect. At n=40 the exact test cannot reject at any effect size unless at least 7 tasks are discordant in the same direction, i.e. a risk difference of at least 0.175; power against the programme's own registered 5-percentage-point minimum important difference is 1-2%. Detecting 5 pp at 80% power needs 430 tasks in the most favourable discordance regime and 863-1708 in plausible ones. BugsInPy at the pinned commit contains 501 numeric bugs in total and 295 within the 8 registered projects, so the registered 5 pp MID is NOT attainable on this benchmark at any task count under this test, and is attainable at psi=0.10 only by consuming most of the benchmark.
power_note.repetitions_tradeoff: 3 repetitions match E30-R11 and satisfy the suite's minimum_stochastic_repetitions. E30-R11 documented 2-6 tasks per arm flipping success across reps, so 5 reps would reduce task-level misclassification. Repetitions buy reliability, not power: the test is on tasks, so the arithmetic floor of 7 discordant tasks is unchanged. R12 stays at 3.

question: With patches canonicalized at emission so they actually apply, do the four registered solver arms separate on real BugsInPy repair, on the registered failing-test endpoint and on the full-regression critical-failure endpoint?

routing_preregistered.terminal: LANE_DEFECT: halt, receipt, re-freeze; no endpoint is read

INTERFACE_STILL_BROKEN: R12 reports that emission-side canonicalization did not materially raise the apply rate; E1/E2 are reported with the measured apply rate attached to every number, and the study does not claim to have tested repair

statistics.intervals: paired task bootstrap, 10000 draws, PROJECT-stratified, seed 20260903

E2_family.correction: Holm step-down, alpha 0.05, computed independently of the E1 family

pinned_pool_for_scale_up.counted_on: inputs/BugsInPy-base/projects/*/bugs, numeric ids only, all carrying bug.info

reuse_custody.r11_is_never_written: every R12 write lands under the R12 campaign directory; the symlinked trees are read-only for this lane
symlinked_read_only: prepared (gold-blind solver workspaces the requests name by absolute path)
evaluator_private (the oracle tree; the adapter only copytree()s out of it)
inputs (the pinned BugsInPy checkout and project mirrors)
baseline_lanes (gold patches, read only by GR0b)

substrate.task_identity_source: E30-R11's frozen substrate, REUSED rather than regenerated: the same 40 task ids, the same gold-blind requests, the same prepared/solver_public workspaces, the same evaluator_private oracle tree and the same per-project runtimes. R12's campaign copies the requests and the frozen task table and symlinks the read-only trees; only responses and evaluations are new. Reuse rather than re-materialization is deliberate: it makes the arm code and the served-model pin the ONLY differences between R11's inputs and R12's, so a difference in outcome cannot be attributed to a re-built substrate.

conditions.E2: EXCLUDE WITH COUNT from every E2 contrast and report the excluded ids
conditions.meaning: the baseline suite for the task contains no test that passes before patching, so no test can become a new failure

conditions.E1: RETAIN in the denominator (E1 runs the registered test binding, not the module suite)
conditions.E2: RETAIN for any_critical_new_failure; record full_regression_suite_passed as CANNOT_CHECK
conditions.meaning: the registered failing test is order-dependent and already fails inside the full-module suite run, so full_regression_suite_passed is ill-defined for it

conditions.E1: RETAIN in the primary denominator (arm-independent and concordant-negative by construction, so it carries no discordant information and cannot bias a paired contrast); ALSO report a pre-registered sensitivity denominator of 39 excluding it
conditions.detection: this one is not machine-detectable from the baseline pass; it is carried as a named pre-outcome substrate finding from PC-R6 GR0(b) and is applied only if the R12 GR0(b) gold control reproduces the same failure for the same task
conditions.meaning: the fixed commit adds a fixture the BugsInPy checkout never copies, so no source-only patch can flip the registered test

task_dispositions_registered_pre_dispatc.rule: dispositions are keyed to machine-detected, arm-independent substrate condition codes emitted by the baseline pass, never to task names or to observed arm outcomes; applying them after seeing R12 outcomes would be criterion_mutation, a registered hard failure

title: Confirmatory BugsInPy re-run under a registered channel request-body contract

why_this_study_exists.measured_root_cause: the bound z.ai Anthropic-compatible channel spends the whole registered output budget on an extended-thinking content block before emitting any text. The arm reads only text blocks, so it receives nothing and records an envelope failure carrying no model output.
why_this_study_exists.the_finding_that_makes_this_a_study_and_: PINNING A SERVED MODEL ID DOES NOT PIN AN EXPERIMENTAL CONDITION. All 119 of E30-R12's envelopes recorded exactly one served model id, glm-5.3, equal to the frozen value, and its GR0c served-model condition held for every envelope written. The drift is in channel BEHAVIOUR at a FIXED served id, which no registered gate in the programme observed.
why_this_study_exists.the_hole_in_e30_r12s_design: model_binding registered the channel, the base URL, the requested model, the frozen served model, the served-model assertion and the per-envelope served-id record. It registered NO request-body contract, so the condition was inherited from a provider default that was then free to move.
why_this_study_exists.what_happened: E30-R12 dispatched its registered chain and halted during model dispatch with 119 of 480 responses written, 116 of them envelope failures whose output tokens sat at or above the registered 6000 cap with the diagnosis 'model did not return a JSON object', 0 of 480 evaluations, no gate computed and no endpoint read.
why_this_study_exists.why_a_new_campaign_identity: E30-R12's 3 completed envelopes were produced under the provider default. Pooling them into a differently configured campaign would mix two channel conditions inside one paired contrast while every registered gate still passed. R13 makes its own 480 responses in its own campaign directory, and its setup refuses to start unless responses/ and evaluations/ are empty.
